analyst_view.overall: Sassuolo (17th, five straight defeats, 29 conceded in 11 games) play their first game under Roberto D'Aversa, who replaced the sacked Aquilani and wants more balance and a change of attitude. Adzic is ruled out with a knee problem and Volpato is reported out too (both counted by the numbers); Berardi, whom the numbers count as available, is the open question: one line-up guide updated Saturday lists him as recovered and starting, another still has him doubtful with Dominguez in his place. Genoa (13th, four wins in their last six) under De Rossi have almost the whole squad, with Frendrup still to be assessed and Osmajic expected up front. Referee Maria Sole Ferrieri Caputi has a one-game Serie A record here, which the numbers blend toward the average.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals, already cut heavily for Sassuolo's missing attackers (Adzic -14%, Volpato -4%). Volpato is now reported out, so the possible return I weighed before is gone, and a first game under a cautious new coach points lower; Berardi may still start, which the numbers already assume, so only a small lean down to about 2.45.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.9 corners. A more cautious Sassuolo might defend deeper and give Genoa more, but Genoa have won few corners lately (20 in six), so the two pull in opposite directions; I stay at about 8.9.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards, with a referee record of one game that tells little. A first game under a new coach who demands more fight, in a game near the bottom, tends to bring more duels and tactical fouls; a small lean up to about 4.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.7 shots. D'Aversa's first priority is a more compact side after 29 goals conceded, and De Rossi's Genoa are also well organised, which points to a slower game with fewer chances; a small trim to about 24.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.3 shots on target, already low for Sassuolo's poor shooting lately (14 on target in six). With Volpato now out and Berardi not certain to start, plus a more cautious game plan, I trim slightly to about 8.1.
